name: Seared Sage Pork Chop with Crunchy Apple, Celery & Pumpkin Seed Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add to the bowl, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing and shallot.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples; add to the bowl.
Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates; top salad with pumpkin seeds and enjoy!
author: Mealime
